R342-03 — home-problem-wrap ledger, REGENERATED against the frozen spec by scripts/build-problem-mapping.py (re-run after changing Live.tsx hooks). The R337 ledger's off-by-one seat bindings (titleblock→titlebox window, bodyzone→artzone window) are corrected; the TRUE paths bind the structural chain (wrap→section window, toprule, frame, inner, head, band, bandrule, bandinner) + the head cells (titleblock, subwrap, kicker, kickertext, titlebox, h2, sub); the per-column windows bind every seat with an honest counterpart (col, colrule, meta, keyroll, keytext, indexroll, indextext, metarule, cue, bodyzone, artzone, artcolor, artin, artsvg, textzone, tgrid, titlebox.N, itemtitle, anszone, answrap, bodytext, zonerule), classified from each recording's own measured geometry and kept only when the window is unique per bp; the 390 swiper-rail spans bind our belt's own bars (problem.dotbar.1..4). The reference's svg line-art shapes (content art),
plumbing, 0x0 tween wrappers, the 0-width swiper mask span and the colliding deep windows are excused with written reasons. ourSection: section#live.pm-section (sections/Live.tsx — the ruled ledger of four problems).
